PINNED-FUNCTION SCREEN: config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json pins camera_init_for_gamemode in game/world/camera and DistanceToClosestPlayer/InitLighting/InitItemInfoData in game/world/items; game/ui/options has NO pin. camera_init_for_gamemode WAS edited (it holds the 15-arm switch) -- deliberately, because the pin hash-asserts COMPILED BYTES, not source text, so a byte-identical respelling passes it and any drift aborts the build fail-closed. Every build re-applied the pins with no hash-drift abort, which is independent confirmation of byte-identity.
attributes.residual: ONE site left raw, with the cause named: options.c:1527 mbBlitCalcWidth's FIRST argument, *(void**)(p + 7660) (= b->blit). Converting it regresses do_controlsmenu from real 62 to real 72 -- instruction COUNT stays 97/97 but the opcode multiset DIFFERS (target-only +1 li +1 mr; ours-only -2 addi). Isolated in three gated steps: b->x and b->y alone convert byte-identically (COMMITTED); adding b->blit reproduces the 62->72 regression exactly, whether or not x/y are converted, so the blit load is the sole cause. Mechanism: the raw cast form at +7660 blocks CSE with the b->blit use one line below (options.c:1529 mbBlitProject(b->blit, b->w, b->h)); the typed form merges both into one address web across the intervening call, so MWCC re-derives the base with addi at both points instead of the target's materialize-once-and-copy (li/mr) shape. This is a protected web -- leave it raw. NOTE this REFINES claim.pad1cd4-7644-is-ctlblit-not-a-player-field.20260831.v1, which prescribed converting all three offsets in one line: two of the three convert, the blit does not.
